thread:
elaine: FYI — creating this thread to lock down a PIR for the outage earlier (svc-ingest spike). Current ask: pick a host, confirm attendees, and agree pre-read. Incident timeline + mitigation are in the incident doc: https://rwinf.internal/incidents/INC-2026-0423
sam: I can host if needed but have a customer demo Tue afternoon. prefer Wed morning PT. who else needs to be there?
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-0423 — severity: SEV2 — impacted: 2% of requests, short tail errors during autoscale. Automated mitigations: temporarily increased pool size; rollback of recent deploy. Runbook link: https://rwinf.internal/runbooks/ingest-spike
ryan: I handled the rollback and watched the traffic for ~30m. happy to be on the call. Wed 09:00 PT works for me.
priya: I'll attend for customer-impact notes and to capture support escalations. Wed morning OK. also want to review the canary config that failed.
vika: I can do the facilitation/host if sam prefers not to. I can write the pre-read and own action tracking. Wed 09:00 PT fine.
markus: heads-up — infra wants to propose a follow-up patch for autoscaler cooldown tuning. can present. Tue only free after 15:00 PT though.
elaine: thanks all. consensus seems Wed 09:00 PT. I'll post a calendar invite once we confirm duration. propose 60 mins + 15 mins buffer.
sam: 60 + 15 works. can we get the prod metrics dump into the pre-read? latency p95/p99 and K8s pod churn.
vika: yep, I'll assemble a 1-pager pre-read: timeline, mitigation, metrics (p50/p95/p99), and tentative action items. will drop in this thread when ready.
ops-bot: Poll created: https://polls.internal/d/INC-2026-0423 — Wed 09:00 PT selected by 4/6. Reminder set 24h before meeting.
ryan: tagging @elaine @vika — please include the logs around the autoscaler events and the deploy hashes. I want to confirm the rollback timing vs request spike.
priya: also add a short customer-impact matrix: affected customers, error types, customer-facing comms required? I can draft comms if we decide it's needed.
vika: added — pre-read draft: https://rwinf.internal/docs/incidents/INC-2026-0423/pre-read.md (WIP). includes graphs + raw query snippets. ping me for any missing bits.
elaine: perfect. final checklist before invite: host = vika, note-taker = priya, oncall reviewer = ryan, infra presenter = markus, eng lead = sam. action owner column in doc = mandatory.
sam: can someone throw in the code snippet we used to roll back? putting it in the doc helps reproduce steps. e.g.,
```
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/ingest-service --to-revision=42
```
markus: i'll add the autoscaler tuning proposal as a separate doc linked in the pre-read.
ops-bot: Reminder: post-incident review must include a timeline + at least one assigned remediation action to close within 30d (policy).
ryan: quick note — if we're short on time Wed we can triage and schedule a follow-up deep-dive for the autoscaler change.
vika: noted. I'll set the invite for 60 mins and add a follow-up slot placeholder (30m) the same week. also will add an action table template to the pre-read.
priya: thanks — i'll draft a customer comms decision tree and post it here before EOD tomorrow.
elaine: thanks everyone — closing loop: invite sent to attendees, pre-read updated at the link above, see you Wed 09:00 PT. If anything blocks earlier, call it out here and we'll reshuffle. :thumbsup:
